title: Finite filtered stages are K-projective
statement: For a split filtration whose successive quotients are coproducts of shifted rank-one free complexes, every finite filtration stage is K-projective.

proof.text: Induct on n. At n = 0, IsZero.eq_of_src shows every map from F 0 is zero; Homotopy.ofEq gives the required null homotopy.
At n + 1, apply the split-extension theorem to step n, the induction hypothesis, the degreewise retractions hsplit n, and the cokernel decomposition hquot n.

proof_origin.place: 2026-10-21 (J9): reuse the already proved upstream theorem with the identical signature and the same finite-stage and telescope proof dependencies; retire the redundant Sheaf copy. No mathematical dependency is pruned.

lean.statement:
theorem isKProjective_of_filtered_free_stage {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    (F : ℕ → CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} A) ℤ)
    (step : ∀ n, F n ⟶ F (n + 1))
    (hzero : IsZero (F 0))
    (hsplit : ∀ (n : ℕ) (k : ℤ),
      ∃ r : (F (n + 1)).X k ⟶ (F n).X k,
        (step n).f k ≫ r = 𝟙 ((F n).X k))
    (hquot : ∀ n, ∃ (I : Type (max u v)) (degree : I → ℤ),
      Nonempty (cokernel (step n) ≅
        ∐ (fun i : I ↦
          (HomologicalComplex.single (ModuleCat.{max u v} A) (.up ℤ) (degree i)).obj
            (ModuleCat.of A (ULift.{v} A))))) :
    ∀ n, (F n).IsKProjective
